newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PM KLAUS TO MEET SWITZERLAND'S DELAMURAZ.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PM KLAUS TO MEET SWITZERLAND'S DELAMURAZ.

text.p: Czech Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus will visit Switzerland on Thursday to meet Economics Minister Jean-Pascal Delamuraz in Bern for a working lunch before attending a conference in Montreaux, Klaus's office said on Wednesday.

Klaus had been scheduled to participate in the Montreaux Winconference, but talks on a government economic package and a cabinet reshuffle, announced last week after a sharp drop in the value of the Czech crown, had put the trip in doubt.
His visit to Switzerland will conclude on Friday, Klaus's office said in a statement.
